frontmatter.title: Rails adds include_seconds option to datetime_field.
frontmatter.dek: Rails now allows to omit seconds part in the input field by adding the include_seconds option to datetime_field.

frontmatter.title: Rails preserves entry TTL when incrementing or decrementing an integer value.
frontmatter.dek: Rails now preserve expires_in while incrementing or decrementing an integer value in MemoryStore to be more consistent with MemCacheStore and RedisCacheStore.

frontmatter.title: Rails adds beginless range support to clusivity
frontmatter.dek: Rails now adds support to include the beginless range in active record inclusivity/exclusivity validators.

frontmatter.title: Rails avoids queries when performing calculations on contradictory relation
frontmatter.dek: Rails now avoids making a query to the database if the calculation contains a contradictory relation.

frontmatter.title: Overuse of Rails engines
frontmatter.dek: In this post, we will see how the overuse of engines could lead to some serious issues.

frontmatter.title: Rails for Multi database defines reading_request? in resolver
frontmatter.dek: Rails moves reading_request? method from the DatabaseSelector to the DatabaseSelector::Resolver class so that we can override the method in custom Resolver.

frontmatter.title: Rails allows specifying the maximum number of records that will be destroyed in a single background job.
frontmatter.dek: Rails adds an active record configuration to limit the maximum number of dependent records destroyed in a single background job.

frontmatter.title: Rails allows using aliased attributes with insert_all and upsert_all
frontmatter.dek: Rails is continuously adding convenience to make active record queries more flexible. Now, Rails has added support to use aliased attributes with insert/upsert_all.

frontmatter.title: Rails 7 adds support for deferrable foreign key constraints in PostgreSQL
frontmatter.dek: By default, foreign key constraints in PostgreSQL are checked after each statement. This works for most use cases but becomes a major limitation when creating related records before the parent record is inserted into the database.

frontmatter.title: Rails 7 adds optional transaction arguments to with_lock
frontmatter.dek: With Rails 7 we can pass transaction arguments like isolation, joinable, etc directly to with_lock.

frontmatter.title: Rails 7 adds caching? and uncachable! helper
frontmatter.dek: Starting with Rails 7, we can add caching? helper to check whether the current code path is being cached and uncacheable! helper to avoid fragment caching.
